notes.title: Shadows of Zana Update
notes.content: [p]The player character and many game objects have had many improvements to particle and animation effects.[/p][p]An option to adjust Screen Shake Intensity has been added to the Settings Menu.[/p][p]Screen Shake Intensity now has 5 settings ranging from very light to very intense. Screen Shake can also be turned off completely. [/p][p]Some tilesets and backgrounds have also been updated.[/p]

notes.title: Shadows of Zana development Update
notes.content: [p]In addition to the facial expressions, a language select screen will prompt the player when launching the game for the first time. Language can be changed in the settings menu as well.[/p][p][/p][p]Some small fixes to bugs and typos have been fixed as well.[/p][p][/p][p]-SnuggleFry Games.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE LOCALIZATION
notes.content: [p]Localization is now being worked on.  SNUGGLEFRY GAMES will continue to add localization moving forward.[/p][p]Enjoy![/p]
